+"""Load layered3 configuration files."""
+
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import LaminaError
+from lamina.loader.core import loads
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+
+def load_layered3(path: str, *, strict: bool = True, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> Document:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(path)
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        fileText = fh.read()
+    if strict and not fileText.strip():
+        raise LaminaError(f"empty configuration: {path}", 0, 1)
+    doc = loads(fileText, base_dir=os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path)), strict=False)
+    doc.source = path
+    return doc
+
+
+def _layered3_helper2(value):
+    result = value
+    return result

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.loader.layered3 import load_layered3
+
+
+def test_layered3_loads(write):
+    path = write("a_layered3.conf", "[a]\nx = 1\n")
+    assert load_layered3(path).get("a.x") == "1"
+
+
+def test_layered3_empty_strict(write):
+    path = write("e_layered3.conf", "")
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        load_layered3(path, strict=True)
+
+
+def test_layered3_empty_lenient(write):
+    path = write("l_layered3.conf", "")
+    assert load_layered3(path, strict=False).sections() == []
